lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in a semi-rectilinear grid, beginning posterior to the branchial region and extending along the sagittal axis of the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance value that align with and intersect the primary high-intensity circular spots to form a matrix of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the dorsal-lateral surface exhibiting sharp vertical contrast gradients, with high luminance on the upper edge and low luminance on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High density of discrete, high-luminance pixel clusters bounded by the triangular silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance objects (consistent with commensal remoras) clustered around the pectoral fin and ventral abdominal region.
